examples.prompt: Create mature developer Dash presenting an open paw toward empty space on the right. Use the resolved developer welcome master as face and anatomy authority, and the guide pose when available. Preserve amber/brown eyes, orange and cream markings, purple hoodie with plain chest, one complete fluffy tail and polished 3D shading. Keep the entire character in frame. Deliver a PNG cutout with real alpha. No text, code, logo, watermark or editorial face proportions.

examples.prompt: Create new cute editorial Dash seated and waving for a community thank-you card. Use the attached verified editorial hoodie master for face, compact proportions and 2D drawing. Preserve amber/brown eyes, orange fur, cream muzzle and cheeks, triangular ears, tuft, dark nose and paws, one full cream-tipped tail, and purple hoodie with cream drawstrings and plain chest.
